sections.heading: Zaman bir adım geriye kayar
sections.body:
Birinin sözünü aktarırken (said / told) fiil genellikle bir zaman geriye gider:

SöylenenAktarılan
“I am tired.”He said (that) he was tired.
“I work in London.”She said she worked in London.
“I'm going home.”He said he was going home.
“I will call you.”She said she would call me.
“I can help.”He said he could help.
“I saw it.” / “I've seen it.”She said she had seen it.

that konuşmada genellikle atılır. Türkçedeki “-dığını söyledi” yapısı.

sections.heading: Diğer değişenler
sections.body:
SöylenenAktarılan
I / myhe, she / his, her
today / tonightthat day / that night
tomorrow / yesterdaythe next day / the day before
here / thisthere / that

“I'll see you tomorrow.” → She said she would see me the next day.

say mı tell mi? (11. aşamadan hatırlatma) He said that… / He told me that… ✘ He said me.

sections.heading: İletişim fiilleri
sections.body:
İngilizceOkunuşTürkçe
explain«ik-[spleyn]»açıklamak (explain to me; ✘ explain me)
mention«[men]-şın»bahsetmek
reply«ri-[play]»cevap vermek
repeat«ri-[piit]»tekrarlamak
complain«kım-[pleyn]»şikâyet etmek
agree / disagree«ı-[grii]» / «dis-ı-[grii]»katılmak / katılmamak (✘ I am agree)
argue«[aa]-gyuu»tartışmak
shout / whisper«şaut» / «[{w}is]-pı»bağırmak / fısıldamak

✘ I am agree. → ✔ I agree. (agree fiildir, am gerekmez)
✘ Can you explain me? → ✔ Can you explain it to me?
